caption:
The FLUX team dropped a new image model and it's free to try 👀

FLUX 3 Klein makes images from text, puts text on signs and posters, and edits with up to 10 reference photos.
Small model, open weights, runs in your browser.

Comment FLUX and I'll DM you the link.

#ai #aitools #flux #aiart #imagegenerator #opensource #design
summary_cs: Nový obrázkový model FLUX 3 Klein od Black Forest Labs, zdarma v prohlížeči. Text na obrázek, editace fotek, až 10 referencí a rozmístění pomocí boxů.
script: The FLUX team just dropped a new image model, and you can use it for free. You type what you want, and you get this. It's called FLUX 3 Klein. It's small, only 5.6 billion parameters, and the weights are open. It can put text on signs, posters and packaging. And you can upload up to ten reference photos and edit with them. No subscription, no credits. It runs right in your browser. Comment FLUX and I'll send you the link.
